content: Bare-metal lifecycle patterns elsewhere: Omni bare-metal infra provider = PXE stack (DHCP proxy on :67/:4011 broadcast, TFTP :69 serving undionly.kpxe, iPXE handler, Image Factory boot) + Talos 'Agent Mode' (metal-agent extension) + SideroLink + BMC power control via IPMI or Redfish (Redfish probed and preferred by default; auto-discovers BMC IP/user/pass from the agent, or set InfraMachineBMCConfig manually BEFORE acceptance). Accepting a machine WIPES ALL DISKS. Concepts worth borrowing for a homelab tool: machine classes/pools as label matchers, hardware discovery attributes (arch, cores, disks, MAC), out-of-band power control. Concepts NOT worth borrowing at homelab scale: DHCP-proxy/TFTP/iPXE infrastructure, agent-mode extensions, autoscaling (Cluster Autoscaler/Karpenter), cloud infra providers. MAAS/Tinkerbell occupy the same PXE+BMC+workflow-engine niche and are heavy multi-service deployments.
